boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Mary study environments, including library, student-center, dining, commuter, and residence-community spaces.

cards.title: Welder Library
cards.subtitle: Individual and group study spaces, plus computer workstations
cards.notes: Use the library for a quiet research session, a group meeting, or computer-based work; confirm seasonal hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines quiet study areas, group spaces, printing, and computer workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Welder Library provides individual and group study spaces, computer workstations, and printing for students and faculty.
cards.access_notes: For students and faculty; September–April hours are Monday–Thursday 7:30 AM–10 PM, Friday 7:30 AM–6 PM, and weekends noon–6 PM. Breaks and holidays may change hours.

cards.title: Lanterman Lodge
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Settle into one of the lodge’s study nooks for reading or laptop work amid the indoor greenery, water features, and aquarium.
cards.short_summary: A year-round indoor green space with cozy study nooks in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Lanterman Lodge has cozy study nooks, tropical flora, waterfalls, and a 10-foot aquarium in the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center; the university describes the center as a gathering space for students, faculty, and visitors.

cards.entity_name: Tom and Frances Leach Foundation Living Room
cards.title: Tom and Frances Leach Foundation Living Room
cards.subtitle: Upper level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy task to the tables or cushioned seating and use the windowed Missouri River view as a daylight break.
cards.short_summary: A window-lined student-center living room with tables, cushioned seating, and a stone fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Leach Foundation Living Room has tables and cushioned seating for studying, a large stone fireplace, and panoramic Missouri River views.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: On the upper level of the Lumen Vitae University Center, across from Susanne’s Coffee Shop.

cards.title: Starion Bank Living Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Choose a booth when your work needs power and a laptop display; each booth has electrical and USB outlets plus a connectable TV.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level living room with powered booths, screens, tables, and cushioned seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starion Bank Living Room has four booths with electrical and USB outlets and TV screens for connecting a laptop, along with tables and cushioned seating.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center; events may be scheduled in the room.

cards.title: Student Involvement Center Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Use either soundproofed study room for focused solo or small-group work, and connect a laptop to the wall-mounted screen as needed.
cards.short_summary: Two focused study rooms with soundproofed doors and laptop-connectable displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Involvement Center has two study spaces with wall-mounted flat-screen TVs that connect to laptops and soundproofed doors.
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center; the nearby conference room requires Student Development permission for student-group reservations.

cards.title: Commuter's Lounge
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Commuter students can work here between classes using the supplied computer and printer, then store essentials in the cubbies.
cards.short_summary: A commuter-focused campus base with a computer, printer, storage cubbies, and kitchen appliances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commuter's Lounge includes a computer, printer, storage cubbies, microwave, refrigerator, and freezer.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Created specifically for commuter students; beside the Starion Bank Living Room under the staircase on the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center.

cards.title: Crow's Nest Lower-Level Study Space
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Use the lower-level study area for a late work session; plan around dining activity and bring your own materials or laptop.
cards.short_summary: A dining-adjacent study area in the student center’s Crow’s Nest restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crow’s Nest lower level offers study space, and the restaurant is open 24 hours a day for students during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Crow’s Nest Campus Restaurant | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located in the Lumen Vitae University Center. During the academic year, the Crow’s Nest is open 24/7 for students; summer hours are listed as 7 AM–10 PM daily and may vary.

cards.title: North Hall Community Lounge
cards.subtitle: North Hall residence community
cards.notes: North Hall residents can use a community lounge for a change of setting, with a kitchen and dining space available in the hall.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall community lounge with kitchen and dining amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: North Hall has three community lounges; its community lounge includes a full kitchen and dining space, and the hall lists computer labs and Wi-Fi among amenities.
cards.access_notes: North Hall is an all-male residence hall; this lounge is intended for its residence community.

cards.title: Hillside Hall Floor Lounges
cards.subtitle: Hillside Hall residence community
cards.notes: Hillside residents can take reading or small-group work to a floor lounge, using the furnished microwave, sink, and counter space.
cards.short_summary: Smaller furnished floor lounges in a suite-style residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Each Hillside Hall floor has smaller lounge areas where students can study; the lounges include a microwave, sink, and counter space.
cards.access_notes: Hillside Hall is a women’s residence for upperclasswomen; its floor lounges serve that residence community.

cards.title: Saint Scholastica Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Third floor of Roers Hall
cards.notes: Eligible Saint Scholastica residents can use the lounge for studying and conversation within this intentional residence-life community.
cards.short_summary: A study-capable lounge within the Saint Scholastica residence-life community.
cards.evidence_claim: Students in Saint Scholastica Hall use its lounge area to study and have conversations.
cards.source_title: Saint Scholastica Hall | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Roers Hall and limited to women admitted to the Saint Scholastica Hall residence-life community.
